purpose: Controls the link between a holder's record of a person and that person's own online card: find, link, unlink, refresh.
namedChanges: `link.ts` is split (RuleGhsSplitFile): lines 16-55 (`LinkReading`, `readLink`) stay in the unit `online-card-link`, a peer; lines 56-100 (`LinkRefusedError`, `LinkWrite`, `linkWrite`, `unlinkWrite`) and lines 13-14 (`LINK_SLUG`, which only these use) are `src/linkWrite.ts`. `LINK_SLUG` is outside the brief's range 56-100 and is added by the placement rule: a symbol used by one new unit goes into it.

In `controller.ts`: the import of `readLink` and the type `LinkReading` from `./link.ts` is the peer `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-online-card-link`; `linkWrite`, `unlinkWrite` and the type `LinkWrite` come from `./linkWrite`; `resolveOnlineCard` and the type `ResolveOutcome` from `./anchorResolver.ts` are the peer `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-person-connections`; the type `PlatformClient` from `../platform.ts` is the peer `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-record-sync`; the own-file imports lose `.ts`.

In `find.ts` and `publicCard.ts`: the imports from `../platform.ts` (`request`, `routeUrl`, `retryAfterMs`, `expectStatus`, `PlatformError`, `PlatformClient`, `RequestBound`) are the peer `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-record-sync`; the own-file imports lose `.ts`.

In `rungs.ts`: the import from `../connections/placements.ts` (`ATOMIC_PLACEMENTS`, `CONTEXT_WORDS`, `DEPTH_WORDS`, `atomicRungTerm`, `placementLabel`, the type `AudienceDepth`) is the peer `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-person-connections`.
Comments made generic (person names, cycle and ticket tags, app names, a claim name and a platform file name removed from the files' comments); no code change.

Beyond the source (Kai, 2026-11-01): `OnlineCardField` keeps `composite`, the id of the address (`t:PlaceClaim`) a field belongs to, as the public-card route now serves it, and `parseOnlineCard` adds it to the line-dedup key when a field has one, so two addresses that name one place at one rung keep a line each. A field without `composite` is read and deduplicated exactly as before. Kai asked for their address to be shown the way MyNet shows it (names, never addresses).
